messages:
Maya: Monday micro-poll — pick three emojis that describe your vibe today. The most delightfully weird combo gets a mystery snack left on the top shelf of the kitchen by noon. Rules: no repeats, be kind. :smile::sparkles:

Jamal: :coffee: :sunglasses: :rocket: — mission caffeine launch. I'm claiming 'top shelf' rights. :raised_hand:

Priya: :cucumber: :blush: :100: — trying to be healthy but also competitive. if i win pls donate muffin to Liam. :pleading_face:

Liam: :taco: :zzz: :robot: — I am simultaneously asleep and efficient. Also, who hid my red mug? :mag:

Evelyn: :seedling: :sparkles: :trophy: — planting good vibes and collecting trophies. Also voting for Jamal's rocket, lol.

Maya: @Liam the mug mystery is now an official general mystery. if you want it back, leave a breadcrumb (or emoji) and we'll launch a retrieval op. :laughing:

Liam: breadcrumb: :bread: — I will accept a bread breadcrumb as evidence. also +1 for ops.

ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen policy — label communal snacks with `Name - YYYY-MM-DD` if you're adding something you want tracked. Fridge temp logs updated at 09:00.

Priya: Good call, ops-bot. quick sticky note method works too. :memo:

Jamal: also quick kudos — @Maya for organizing 'mystery snack diplomacy'. :tada: :clap:

Maya: thanks! tiny office fun > big meetings. i'll drop the snack at 11:45 and annotate with 'mystery'. may the weirdest emoji combo win. :mage:

Evelyn: ps — can we add an 'emoji hall of fame' board? just a sticky wall. low effort, high joy. :pushpin:

Liam: yes to the board. i'll bring colorful sticky notes.

Priya: i'll make a tiny legend.

Jamal: emo-board incoming. I'll add a doodle of a rocket muffin. :rocket::cupcake:

Maya: winners announced at 12:00. go wild. :boom:
